<thought>Based on the mapped reaction, the product is an aniline (Nc1ccccc1). The SNAr template replaces a chlorine on the aromatic ring with an amine. Therefore the retrosynthetic precursors are the corresponding aryl chloride and ammonia. The SMILES for the aryl chloride is "Clc1ccccc1" and for ammonia is "N". This yields a single precursor combination.</thought>
<final_answer>[["Clc1ccccc1", "N"]]</final_answer>
